items.evidence: Win script, seed 1, Normal: wave 6 starts tick 5645; runners (kind runner, health 1, x falls 0.05/tick = 3 u/s) spawn at ticks 5646, 5706, 5766, 5826, so one every 60 ticks = 1.0 s, not 1.5 s. The 15 count is right (wave 6 adds 225 = 15 x 15). lib.rs: spawn_t += 1.0 for runners.

HUD reads 'Wave 5 of 6' / 'Wave 6 of 6', 'Oleada 6 de 6', 'Vague 6 sur 6'. Tick 5644: wave 5 cleared, screen still play. Full clear: won, 675. One runner kill adds 15 (450->465). I stopped shooting at tick 6370: 4 runners got through, then won with 615 and gate 1. Stopping at 6250: lost.

Enter on Language goes en->es->fr->en (Left/Right step and stop at the ends). In French, texts were: title ['Défendez la porte','Commencer','Réglages','Quitter'], settings ['Réglages','Volume : 8','Langue : Français','Difficulté : Normal','Retour'], play ['Score : 10','Vague 1 sur 6','Porte : 5'], paused ['Pause','Reprendre','Titre'], won/lost ['Vous avez gagné'/'Vous avez perdu','Score : N','Entrée : titre']. I looked at all six frames.

Settings texts: Volume, Language, 'Difficulty: Normal', Back. Default normal. On that row Left gives easy (a second Left stays easy), Right gives hard (stays hard), RR then L gives normal; focus stays on index 2. Labels are 'Dificultad: Fácil' in Spanish and 'Difficulté : Difficile' in French. Frame viewed.
Win scripts with saved difficulty. Easy: walkers 1, runners 1. Normal: walkers 2, runners 1. Hard: walkers 3, runners 2. Easy and Normal won with 675; Hard won with 630, gate 2.

Run 1 set volume 6, es, hard with --settings s_m06; run 2 started with 6, es, hard. I hand-wrote a pre-change settings.json {language: es, volume: 3}: it loaded es and 3 with difficulty_setting normal, and play spawned health-2 walkers. A fresh folder starts with en, 8, normal.
Every state has 'difficulty' (easy|normal|hard) and every walker has 'kind' (walker|runner). All 16 --frame outputs are valid PNGs of 800 x 480.
m01-m18 all still pass (read with 'of 6' and 675). m19 does not: README's check command now names another folder (see m19).

CHANGES.md lists each change with its file (lib.rs, fr.json, game.json, settings.json, checks/), what was checked headlessly, and limits. It even states the 1.0 s runner spacing. But its claim that the README path was 'fixed' is false (see defects).

defects: README.md line 15 still names <runs>/medium-engine-3 as the folder; CHANGES.md says this was fixed, which is false.
README.md 'What I checked' still says the winning run scores 450 (now 675).
README says 'Run from anywhere' but its examples use paths relative to <runs>/change-engine-3 (work/frame.png, $(cat work/checks/win_inputs.txt)).
State 'difficulty' reads 'normal' on title/settings until a run starts, even when the setting is hard or easy (documented in CHANGES.md).
Module description in lib.rs still says 'five waves'.

where.how: weighted_by_kind is exact (the run's own token counts times the weights); a step's kind is a reading of its command's text, and answered_tokens / written_tokens are characters / 4
